+from fastapi import FastAPI, APIRouter, Depends
+from fastapi.routing import _EffectiveRouteContext
+
+def test_iter_route_contexts():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    router = APIRouter(prefix="/users", tags=["users"])
+    
+    @router.get("/me")
+    async def read_me():
+        return {"user": "me"}
+    
+    app.include_router(router)
+    
+    # This should fail currently as iter_route_contexts is not implemented
+    contexts = list(app.iter_route_contexts())
+    assert len(contexts) == 1
+    ctx = contexts[0]
+    assert isinstance(ctx, _EffectiveRouteContext)
+    assert ctx.prefix == "/users/me"
+    assert ctx.tags == ["users"]
+
+    # Test with nested router
+    sub_router = APIRouter(prefix="/profile", tags=["profile"])
+    @sub_router.get("/info")
+    async def read_info():
+        return {"info": "info"}
+    
+    router.include_router(sub_router)
+    
+    contexts = list(app.iter_route_contexts())
+    # /users/me and /users/profile/info
+    assert len(contexts) == 2
+    
+    # Find the profile info context
+    profile_ctx = next(ctx for ctx in contexts if ctx.prefix == "/users/profile/info")
+    assert "users" in profile_ctx.tags
+    assert "profile" in profile_ctx.tags
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_iter_route_contexts()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except AttributeError as e:
+        print(f"Caught expected AttributeError: {e}")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Caught unexpected exception: {e}")
+        raise e
